claims.statement: `make lint_prose` installs the configured Vale binary and checks either specified files or `src`, excluding `node_modules` and `src/code-samples`; it is a prose style gate rather than a rendering or factual-correctness check.

The changelog-navigation Node tests use an in-memory DOM to verify that the self-hosted changelog indexes only visible stable minor releases, preserves excluded headings, coalesces mutation updates, cleans up on page changes, and falls back to an inline index without a sidebar.

`make export-htmltest` runs Mint export before htmltest; the export requires a Mint CLI with `mint export`, Node 20 or 22, and an Enterprise plan, while htmltest intentionally checks external URLs only because the export omits many pages.

The release-watch `test_evidence.py` suite uses synthetic payloads and source/page text to test evidence parsing, surgical edit validation, and source-claim matching; it does not exercise remote release, GitHub, or Linear integrations.
